highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.

bullets.detail: Propagates native task and submission failures and rejects draws whose GPU buffers failed to upload, reducing stale-data reuse under memory pressure. Managed flush operations remain void; this update exposes no new failure-result API.

Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

v4.152.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.
